title: Causal AI-Driven Secure mmWave Beam Alignment with Defensive Variational Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.18321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient and secure beam alignment is essential for mmWave communication systems. However, existing deep learning (DL)-based beam alignment methods often neglect causal relationships between inputs and outputs, resulting in limited interpretability, poor generalization, and excessive beam sweeping. Moreover, these DL solutions are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, where small perturbations in received power measurements can mislead beam classifiers. To overcome these issues, we propose a causally-aware DL framework integrating causal discovery into beam alignment. A two-stage causal beam selection algorithm learns a Bayesian graph capturing dependencies between received signal strength indicators (RSSI) as inputs and the optimal beam index as the target variable, then uses it to select a minimal set of relevant input features for the DL classifier. To mitigate adversarial attacks, we introduce a defensive variational autoencoder (DVAE)

translated_title: 基于因果AI驱动的安全毫米波波束对准与防御性变分自编码器
translated_abstract: 高效且安全的波束对准对毫米波通信系统至关重要。然而，现有的基于深度学习（DL）的波束对准方法往往忽视输入与输出之间的因果关系，导致可解释性有限、泛化能力差以及过多的波束扫描。此外，这些深度学习方案容易受到对抗攻击的影响，即接收功率测量中微小的扰动就可能误导波束分类器。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了一种将因果发现融入波束对准的因果感知深度学习框架。该框架中的两阶段因果波束选择算法首先学习一个贝叶斯图，用以捕捉接收信号强度指示（RSSI）作为输入与最优波束索引作为目标变量之间的依赖关系，然后利用该图为深度学习分类器选择一个最小化的相关输入特征集合。为了缓解对抗攻击，我们引入了一种防御性变分自编码器（DVAE）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将因果发现与防御性变分自编码器相结合的因果感知深度学习框架，在提升毫米波波束对准的可解释性与泛化能力的同时，有效抵御对抗攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causally-aware deep learning framework that integrates causal discovery and a defensive variational autoencoder, enhancing the interpretability and generalization of mmWave beam alignment while defending against adversarial attacks.
